crossRefs.note: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

translations.web: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;
translations.bsb: But when his accusers rose to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.
translations.kjv: Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
translations.asv: Concerning whom, when the accusers stood up, they brought no charge of such evil things as I supposed;
